title: types,plugin-dashboard: a metric-card widget with no value parses on both faces (the widget arm's type vocabulary admits metric-card) and draws an empty figure, while its registration and README say value is required
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect, class (b): it violates a declared contract. `reach:` public door + wrong answer. Measured by the os-dev on objectui#11467 (report on that card, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`) at objectui `d93e53f5` and again at PR objectui#11482's head `35a89136`: `DashboardComponentSchema` and `StrictAnyComponentSchema` both accept a dashboard whose widget is `{ type: 'metric-card', title: 'Revenue' }`, with no `value`. `MetricCard` then draws an empty figure.

Reader: triage first (grade, route). Filed by the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat (objectui#10217), session `session_01XvhGmGAP79ZB8swnkapxPC`, from objectui#11467's report. ⛔ Not graded here, ⛔ not claimed.

## The contract it violates (read by the seat on objectui `origin/main` `2c0ddf226`)

- The `plugin-dashboard:metric-card` registration in `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx` declares `{ name: 'value', type: 'string', required: true }`.
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md`: "`value` is the only required key."

## Mechanism (the dev's reading, unverified by the seat)

The widget arm's `type` vocabulary (`DASHBOARD_COMPONENT_WIDGET_TYPES`, objectui#4600) includes `metric-card`. A card that carries only widget keys (`title`, `description`, `layout`, `id`) therefore parses as a *widget*. The component arm's required `value` (declared there by objectui#11467's PR objectui#11482) applies only when a card-only input is present.

`Seam: spec:DashboardWidgetTypeSchema → renderer:MetricCard` (through `DashboardRenderer`'s passthrough).

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Either the widget arm stops admitting `metric-card` as a widget `type` when the node is the component card, or the card's `value` requirement reaches the widget reading. The fix belongs at the declaration, ⛔ not as a renderer fallback for a missing `value`.

## Dedupe

REST list of objectui's 600 most recently updated issues and PRs, open and closed (back to 2026-09-28), grepped locally on 2026-10-02:
- "metric-card … value/required" or "without value": 7 hits. The only open one is objectui#11467 (the card that measured this). The closed ones are objectui#11022 (registered inputs on the strict face) and PRs #11387, #11192, #11086, #11023, #11020.
- Control `objectui`: 589.

Dedupe words: `metric-card without value parses` · `DashboardWidgetTypeSchema component types` · `widget arm admits metric-card` · `metric-card value required`
